body.message:
We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and frustration this situation may have caused you. We completely understand how important it is to have a smooth and comfortable stay, especially when you have already made plans based on your existing reservation.

Unfortunately, due to an unexpected delay with the renewal of the unit’s permit, we are currently unable to provide access to the same apartment for the requested extension. Please be assured that our team has been actively following up and doing everything possible to complete the renewal; however, due to circumstances beyond our control, the process is taking longer than expected.

As a gesture of goodwill and to minimize the inconvenience to you, we would be pleased to upgrade your reservation to a 2-bedroom apartment in Business Bay for this extension, at no additional cost.

Kindly have a look at the below link and let us know if the alternative apartment would be suitable for you. Please note that this alternative arrangement would apply only to this extension period, as we are continuing our efforts to complete the permit renewal for the original apartment.

We truly appreciate your patience, understanding, and cooperation, and we sincerely apologize once again for the inconvenience caused.
